decision.reason: T14 removes the T12 invalid-pair failure mode and shows a positive current-best-quality signal, but it changes the model from gpt-5.3-codex-spark to gpt-5.5/high, reaches only +3.27% average score delta against the T14 >=20% promotion gate, and did not run the reviewer gate. Therefore it is not strict same-model comparability evidence and cannot by itself reverse M26/M35 or promote advisory behavior.
